title: Fix the Incomplete Bubble Sort
description: The program should fully sort an array of numbers in ascending order.
expectedBehavior: The program should print '1 2 5 8 9 ', fully sorted.
actualProblem: The inner loop's bound j < n - 2 stops one comparison too early, so the last pair of elements is never compared or swapped in the first pass, leaving the array not fully sorted.
explanation: Bubble sort's inner loop must compare every adjacent pair not yet guaranteed to be in place — bounding it at n - 1 - i (shrinking as more elements settle) ensures the very last pair is always checked in the first pass.
